latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI-powered video background changer for post-production.

- Change, replace, and customize video backgrounds with AI segmentation.
- Swap backgrounds in real-time, blur distractions, or insert custom images/videos — no green screen required.
- Handles edge precision (hair, objects) and lighting adjustments for natural results.
- Supports multiple use cases: professional, creative, branded, and privacy-focused backgrounds.
- API allows batch processing, background alternatives, and adjustable output formats/resolution.
